title: Transitions
description: Composed transitions per ordered pair, written by pipeline/plan_transitions.py (Chunk 7) to web/public/library/transitions.json and read by the board (web/src/contracts/transitions.ts). Each candidate keeps its plan (moves), compiled recipe (contracts/recipe.schema.json v4, anchored), and critic verdict. Bump schema_version on any breaking change and update both sides.

facts.description: Pair facts given to the composer: tempo/sync, key distance, stems, exit and entry bars.

composer.description: LLM call metadata (model, cached, latency, usage, error); null if only the rules composer ran.

best.description: Index of the highest-scoring valid candidate, or null if none is valid.

plan.description: The candidate as composed: out_start_bar, in_key_shift (moves v5+) and moves (handoff_pipeline/compose/moves.py).

errors.description: Why it didn't compile (empty if it did).

recipe.description: Compiled, anchored C5 v4 recipe; null if it didn't compile.
